title: Upload an audio / video / image / document (24-hour S3 URL)
description:
Synchronous, no credit. Upload an audio / video / image / document
(HTML / PDF / Markdown) file and get back a public S3 URL valid for 24
hours. Use the URL as `audio_url` / `video_url` on /v1/create_video,
paste into `script_text` as an inline `![alt](url)` for images, or
`curl <get_url>` to fetch a document body before passing it as
blog_text / script_text. Server cap 500 MB.

fields.name: file
fields.label: File (audio / video / image / HTML / PDF / Markdown, ≤500 MB)
fields.placeholder: Choose a file — uploaded as multipart/form-data.

use_cases.title: 📎 Upload an asset (audio / video / image / document)
use_cases.description: Pick any audio (mp3 / wav / m4a), video (mp4 / mov / webm), image (jpg / png / webp), or document (html / pdf / md) file ≤ 500 MB. Click **Run** — the response carries a 24-hour public S3 URL you can pass into /v1/create_video as `audio_url` / `video_url`, paste into `script_text` as an inline `![alt](url)` for images, or `curl` the URL to read a document body for blog_text / script_text.
